question: Can independent LLM producer and consumer agents perform an attributable, lawful native AppWorld handoff and record the actual consumer's pre-action judgment and subsequent use/rework?
dataset_split: train; evaluator inspected by research side; development only
selection_rule: Two prospectively chosen distinct train families with natural information-preparation to Venmo-action dependencies; run both in order regardless of first result unless a declared global infrastructure stop occurs; no favorable replacement.

agents.producer: Separate LLM history and separate initial AppWorld world; public read operations only; deliver a structured, source-linked recipient/amount proposal; its world changes are discarded and any write invalidates the observation.
agents.consumer: Separate LLM history and fresh initial AppWorld world; receive only the explicit producer deliverable; may inspect public state before declaring accept/rework/reject; log judgment before write actions; only consumer may execute task changes.

transport_rule: All attempts, errors, retries and unknown token use count against caps. Retry only provider 429/503 within the remaining cap, with at most two retries and logged finite backoff; other transport failure is UNKNOWN, never a task failure.
legal_feedback: Task instruction, API documentation and public runtime observations only. Producer artifact crosses to consumer. Neither agent sees private_data, ground truth, evaluator code, evaluator outcome, or the other's hidden messages/runtime variables. Official evaluator runs after consumer judgment and action are frozen; outcome is scientific analysis only.
stop_rule: Run exactly two task IDs unless the named provider, pinned benchmark or isolation boundary fails. Preserve all partial traces and stop reason; no post hoc task substitution or promotion to confirmation.
cost_currency: USD unavailable unless provider pricing is independently verified; report attempts/tokens/time and unknown usage without inventing price
